newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Damansara buys stake in Long Huat.
newsitem.headline: Damansara buys stake in Long Huat.

text.p: Property and timber firm Damansara Realty Bhd said on Monday it has bought a 32 percent stake in Long Huat Group Bhd for 148.41 million ringgit in cash.
In a statement, Damansara said the 11.8 million shares in timber concern Long Huat was bought in an off-market transaction and was financed from borrowings.
Damansara also announced the proposed acquisition of a property development firm, Golden Dragon Garden Sdn Bhd, for 250 million ringgit in cash.
It also announced a proposal to buy a piece of land in eastern Pahang state for 40 million ringgit.

The company said the Long Huat acquisition would help integrate its upstream timber operations as a timber concession holder and logger, with Long Huat's downstream activities in the sector. Long Huat's subsidiaries manufacture and export timber products.

"The proposed acquisition would also present an opportunity...to expand its activities regionally. This is because the enlarged (Long Huat) Group would have operations in Papua New Guinea as well as Laos," Damansara said.
The statement said the acquisition of Golden Dragon provides Damansara with an opportunity to expand its earnings base from rental income to include property development.
Golden Dragon is developing a commercial township on a 42.4-hectare land in northern Perak state which is expected to generate sales of around 1.1 billion ringgit, the statement said.
The proposed land acquisition was aimed at increasing Damansara's land bank for future development, it added.
Damansara requested for the lifting of its stock trading suspension. The stock was suspended from April 4 and was last traded at 1.54 ringgit.
